_comment: The bug reporter's lists: the ONE source for the desktop Bugs page (src/gui/loaders.rs load_bug_taxonomy), the website's Bugs page (web/pages/bugs-app.js fills its menus from this file) and the relay, which keeps a report's severity and category only when they are on these lists (src/relay/bug_taxonomy.rs, built in). Each entry is shown as written; its id is the same word in lower case. Add an entry here and it appears everywhere, with no code change. Until 2026-10-24 the relay and the website kept their own lists, so the desktop's categories were all stored as other.
